name: Right Sexx! SIdeA

A strange object flew from somewhere and when Miki, a fresh teacher, exposed to some light from it, she grew a dick! And at the same time, Yuu, her male childhood friend, became a girl!

The first chapter of a comical transgender story.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088660.html]DLsite English[/url]]

滑稽的变性人故事的第一章。
